notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Greetings and Thanks for playing the game. 

This is huge update. 

-Optimized all assets and environment. Now improved and smooth gameplay
-Many bug fixes
-Enhanced and improved environment lighting 
-Fixed a major bug where light shadows causing problems

I am a solo developer and tried my best to fix all the issues mentioned in negative reviews.
